strategy.overview: Phantom Ship makes the yellow, green, and red drop targets the direct path to its largest awards. The first complete clear prepares Extra Ball at the center-right lane; time that lane for the cannon's EXTRA BALL light. A second complete clear prepares Special; pass the same lane when the cannon shows PREPARE SPECIAL, then collect Special at an outlane. Yellow drops raise Bonus X from 2x through 5x, green drops raise pop-bumper value, and red drops raise spinner value. The right-flipper lanes step the points awarded by each drop target.
strategy.simpleOverview: A first clear of every yellow, green, and red drop target prepares Extra Ball; shoot the center-right lane when the cannon points to EXTRA BALL. A second clear prepares Special; pass the same lane when the cannon points to PREPARE SPECIAL, then collect Special at an outlane.
strategy.summary: Shoot the yellow, green, and red drops deliberately, with yellow first when Bonus X matters. Once an award is prepared, stop shooting drops and wait for the cannon lamp before taking the center-right lane.

quickInfo.name: Prepare Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: First clear of every drop target.

quickInfo.name: Collect Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Center-right lane when the cannon shows EXTRA BALL.

quickInfo.name: Prepare Special
quickInfo.summary: Second clear of every drop target.

quickInfo.name: Collect Special
quickInfo.summary: Prepare it at the center-right lane, then drain through a lit outlane.

steps.text: Clear the yellow, green, and red drop targets once; yellow advances Bonus X, green raises bumper value, and red raises spinner value.
Watch the rotating cannon lamps and shoot the center-right lane when EXTRA BALL aligns.
Clear every colored drop target a second time to prepare Special.
Pass the center-right lane when the cannon shows PREPARE SPECIAL, then collect Special at either lit outlane.

alternatives.title: Value-building route
alternatives.when: Use this when clearing every drop target is unsafe or only one color is reachable.

steps.text: Favor yellow drops for Bonus X, green drops for higher bumper scoring, or red drops for a stronger spinner.
Use the right-flipper lanes to step drop-target value from 15,000 to 20,000 and then 25,000 before returning to that bank.
Collect or finish the first full-bank Extra Ball route.
Clear all colored drops again, time PREPARE SPECIAL at the center-right lane, and take a lit outlane.

machineSetup: Test every colored drop target, the right-flipper value lanes, spinner, three bumpers, center-right lane, rotating cannon lamps, and both outlane Special switches.
Confirm the cannon lamp advances reliably and explain that the Special collect is an intentional lit outlane, not an ordinary safe playfield shot.

techniques.name: Post Pass
techniques.instruction: Post-pass to the right flipper when the safer next action is a right-flipper value lane or the center-right cannon lane.

cautions.issue: Preparing an award is not the same as collecting it.
cautions.response: After each full clear, read the rotating cannon and time the center-right lane; Special then requires a separate lit outlane collect.
